description: lightdni (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: lightdni-jssas-toggle - the theme toggle, no integration needed
content: **lightdni** (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: what it does
content: a TypeScript utility package for applying and toggling CSS themes: theme classes and attributes on the root element, dynamic CSS variables, localStorage/cookie persistence, and accessibility metadata (`color-scheme`, `aria-live` announcements).
one consolidated `setTheme` call - dependency-safe, and at home in vanilla JS/TS, React and Vue projects.
